comparison.objective: Extract a fitted collar with a prepared screw puller, recover it and park the tool; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require bimanual stabilization and repeated rotary actuation. Record turns a coarse screw to generate axial extraction, then transports a loaded tool; candidate unlocks and finely rotates an adjustment collar, relocks it and evaluates impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Record checks at least two screw turns, shaft clearance, jaw retention, collar recovery and stable tool parking. Candidate checks two acceptable stops and lock holding; response thresholds are partly unspecified.
comparison.reason: Shared screw turning and counterholding are generic; force-driven extraction and dynamic parameter tuning have different objectives and outcomes.
